_comment: Overrides for agent_qa/core/profiles.py:Fixtures. Dates and symbols live here as DATA so that a stale probe date is a one-line edit, not a sweep through every test. Point AGENT_QA_FIXTURES at another file to layer a second set on top (e.g. per-environment coverage differences). Only keys that exist on the Fixtures dataclass are applied.
_example: set "equity_day": "2025-06-03" here to move every equity test to a different session
